questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

Mahima is __as smarter as__ Shilpi.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"as smart as"** is used to make a comparison between two entities, indicating that they possess the same level of intelligence. (उतना ही स्मार्ट जितना)

 
 
• **Example: **She is** as smart as **her older brother.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e**. 'as smart as'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Most smart as** (सबसे स्मार्ट जैसा): This phrase is incorrect in English grammar.

 
 
• **Example:** Incorrect: She is the most smart as her friend.
 
 
 
• **More smart as** (ज्यादा स्मार्ट जैसा): This phrase is also incorrect in English grammar.
 
 
• **Example:** Incorrect: He is more smart as his colleague.
 
 
 
• **Smartest than** (सबसे स्मार्ट): This phrase is incorrect because the correct comparative form is "smarter than."
 
 
• **Example:** Incorrect: She is the smartest than everyone in the class.

questions.question:
The following sentence has been divided into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

She / did not watched / Frankenstein / last night.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect form of the verb **"watched"** in the phrase "**did not watched**."
 
• When using the auxiliary verb **"did,"** the main verb should be in** its base form.**
 
• The correct phrase should be "**did not watch**," ensuring grammatical correctness.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 2** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"She **did not watch **Frankenstein last night."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **1: "last night."** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **3: "She"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **4: "Frankenstein"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
